critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck primitive along its longitudinal axis to increase the hump length by 150%. Simultaneously, scale the vertical height of this same primitive by a factor of 1.4 and widen its horizontal profile by 20% at the midpoint. To resolve the abrupt transition, apply a fillet radius to the front edge of the upper-deck geometry where it meets the cockpit area, ensuring a smooth aerodynamic curve rather than a sharp vertex.

discrepancies.observed: A very short hump that ends almost immediately behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and blends into the main fuselage quickly.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct, elevated second story with a clear vertical rise from the main deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase height of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: An abrupt transition between the cockpit area and the hump.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve transitioning from the nose to the upper deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth/round the front edge of the hump geometry

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck appears narrow and vertically oriented.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck has a wider horizontal profile that tapers toward the rear.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase width of the upper-deck primitive
